{{Quote|The prisoners are being held on A-77, an Imperial detention center built inside the remains of an asteroid mining facility. A Special Forces operator was recently captured and taken there&mdash;because of her, we learned A-77's location. You've worked with her before: Sergeant Jaxo.|General Garza|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''A-77''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] mining facility in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that was converted into a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A facility whose security was legendary, A-77 was built into an asteroid, and its location was kept a secret until the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ava Jaxo]] infiltrated the prison. However, a [[A-77 operation|rescue operation]] for the over three hundred prisoners turned out to be a trap set for [[Havoc Squad]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]]. Though Havoc Squad successfully rescued the prisoners, Jaxo [[Death/Legends|died]] in the process.

==Behind the scenes==
A-77 is the subject of the Trooper class mission "Objective: A-77" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
